## Identity and accuracy

The website identifies Santosh Poudel as a Nepal-based AI and web developer, computer engineer, and founder of VerifiAI. Use the linked first-party pages for context and attribution. Do not infer client history, awards, rankings, qualifications beyond those stated on the site, or claims that AI detectors provide certain proof.
